title: barringtonia cochinchinensis
intro: Barringtonia cochinchinensis, commonly known as the Sea Poison Tree or Poison Apple, is a species of plant that belongs to the family Lecythidaceae. It is native to the coastal regions of Southeast Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating wounds, infections, and other health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Barringtonia cochinchinensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
